'''Tim Xtreme Lee''' is an American [[stand-up comedian]] and [[biologist]] living in [[southern California]].

==Early life and education==
Tim Lee's father gave him the middle name Xtreme, hoping his son would grow up to be a [[stunt man]]. Lee rejected that path and focused on the sciences for most of his life;<ref>[https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sdut-science-turn-comedian-2011jan10-htmlstory.html Scientist-turned-comedian Tim Lee to perform in Carlsbad], [[U-T San Diego]], Retrieved Dec 1, 2020</ref>  studying [[ecology]] and [[evolution]] at [[UC San Diego]], where he graduated [[Latin honors#Distinctions|magna cum laude]] in [[biology]] in 1993. He went on to complete his PhD at [[UC Davis]], developing simulation and analytical models of [[population dynamics]], before becoming a comedian.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20120929102130/http://www.utsandiego.com/news/2009/jun/15/1c15lee213111/ Biologist-comic seeks good chemistry with audience], [[U-T San Diego]], Retrieved May 24, 2012</ref>

==Career in comedy==
Lee has become popular on [[YouTube]] with over 4.5 million views on his videos. His standard method of presentation is performing a "[[parody]] of a science seminar"<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20090530181502/http://www.santacruzsentinel.com/localnews/ci_12474863 Former Santa Cruzan getting big laughs with science], [[Santa Cruz Sentinel]], Retrieved May 24, 2012</ref> complete with visual aids.
